I just want to share my personal experience with this phone.

For basic task, it runs really well. I’ve gotten lots of compliments about the camera quality with some even saying its better than an iPhone. I really like the video quality, I use it for my school films a lot. AI is amazing, it is really productive. Charging takes 45m - 1 hour with its 67W.

The negative traits of this phone for me are mainly the heating issue, paint chip problem and optimization.

Although this phone has been out for maybe 2 years now, it kind of feels slow for me on some apps. I still encounter bugs every now and then. Idk why it happens...maybe because of the OS? (Oppo probably hasn't optimized this phone that well.) And for gaming...this phone is HORRIBLE. It heats up so easily unless you're playing with a fan or use an AC (even with that the heat is still noticeable) and when I'm outdoors, even in a shaded area, the battery just decides it does not want to function normally anymore. It drains super fast compared to when I'm just at home. (Like 5% in 30 mins) This phone has a thermal problem probably because it's so thin. Another problem is the paint chips. If you're familiar with the iPhone paint chips on camera lenses, it is like that but on the flat surface on the sides (metal part). I don't know what causes it. I thought it was my phone case but it just gets worse everyday and some of it are starting to look noticeable if you look hard enough. Idk if it only happens to the 'Ocean Blue' variant though, But yeah the color chipping is a huge bummer. If that is a deal breaker for you then don't buy this phone. 

I honestly didn't want this phone but after I graduated I eventually got ₱10k to upgrade my dying phone, my mother already owns this, she bought it for $345. And she offered to sell it to me for like $160 (₱10Kish...) as a graduation gift. Of course, that is an ₱8k discount...and in my country, ₱10k gets you a low-end device so you bet I would rather have a mid ranger than any Helio crap phones. This phone is good besides the build quality and RIDICULOUS price. If you're going to buy it for ₱15,000+, just don't. There are a lot more better option out there.
